dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "We can expect the various commercial routes between us and the other nations to open up one after the other. Better days are coming soon, indeed."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Many thanks to our friends and competitors here in Ritou for helping us to make it this far."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "You're too kind. I think everyone believes that we'll make it as long as there's business to be done."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Haha, that's right! But don't get too chummy or lose your edge now — don't forget that we're rivals out there in the mercantile world!"
